items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: Well that was Rene, Zeb, Morris French... I know Zeb and I went playing with Rene.

ctx.x: Who else was in Rene's band?
Well that was Rene, Zeb, Morris French. The band you play was... Oh, what's the spell name again? I believe it was T-Boy. You hear about it?
